authorizations.purpose: Allow Buddy to diagnose and repair routine internal runtime faults without repeatedly interrupting the Founder.
allowed: read internal service state and loopback health endpoints
read governed logs and receipts with secret redaction
restart specifically allowlisted internal Dominion services
restart specifically allowlisted internal Dominion timers
restart specifically allowlisted fixed-name Dominion containers when their governed health evidence fails
probe every registered governed read-only MCP connector and correlate failures to an allowlisted repair target
remove disposable __pycache__ directories and failed Buddy deploy backup artifacts
restore tracked Buddy runtime source files from the canonical dominion-ops repository after creating a tracked-file rollback snapshot
run compilation, tests, health probes, and source-integrity checks
write internal repair receipts and evidence-backed lessons
forbidden_without_fresh_founder_authoriz: spend or move money
place or modify trades or orders
sign certify file or submit legally binding material
change credentials secrets authentication policy or access tokens
change firewall rules public ingress DNS or security boundaries
delete business databases customer data financial data or durable mission evidence
rewrite BUDDY_CONSTITUTION.md or standing_authorizations.json
force-push rewrite git history or bypass required repository protections
enable a quarantined or previously forbidden agent or service
perform arbitrary shell commands outside reviewed repair recipes
restart arbitrary containers services or timers whose exact identifiers are not hard-coded in a reviewed repair recipe
requirements: use an allowlisted repair recipe only
create rollback material when files are changed
rollback when acceptance fails and rollback is technically possible
report unresolved or high-consequence failures as HELD or BLOCKED instead of pretending they were fixed

authorizations.purpose: Keep the Dominion Brain / Obsidian operational mirror synchronized continuously without Founder babysitting while preserving the existing truth, security, and consequence boundaries.
allowed: automatically render and publish the Dominion Brain from the exact current main commit after relevant governed source changes
run an hourly reconciliation against the current main commit so missed or interrupted synchronization self-recovers
update the generated Dominion-Brain mirror through the reviewed production publish workflow
seed only missing sanitized operator-owned note files without overwriting existing operator notes
reload the already-governed vault Caddy route while preserving authenticated access
verify loopback-only backend binding, authenticated external health, and unauthenticated HTTP 401 enforcement
serialize production work through the foundation-vm-production concurrency boundary
record exact commit SHA, validation outcome, publish outcome, route acceptance, rollback state, and workflow receipt
forbidden_without_fresh_founder_authoriz: make the Dominion vault unauthenticated or publicly readable
publish customer records secrets tokens credentials raw environment values or private keys
change DNS firewall public ingress provider identity authentication policy or credential values
send external messages or customer communications
spend or move money
place or modify live trades or orders
overwrite existing operator-owned note files
force-push rewrite git history or bypass repository protections
expand agent permissions beyond this standing authorization
treat Obsidian as runtime proof when production evidence disagrees
requirements: source must be the exact current main commit
brain input gates and render verification must pass
VM repository synchronization must be fast-forward only
tracked VM state must be clean after synchronization
deployment must preserve rollback material and automatically restore the previous brain generation on failure
authenticated vault route must pass and unauthenticated access must return HTTP 401
no secret values may be written to logs source control receipts prompts or Obsidian
every automatic run must emit a retrievable receipt
failures must remain visible as HELD or BLOCKED and must never be reported as production success
